fact: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Algerian Space Agency are carrying out a project to set up a permanent mechanism for monitoring strategic agricultural sectors through satellite images, which the vegetable and meat office reviewed in January 2026.
title: اعتماد تقنيات الأقمار الصناعية لتحسين تقييم الشُّعب الفلاحية الإستراتيجية
